content:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: High 99th latency for hosted /v1/generate in eu-west-1 detected. Alert triggered by p99 > 1.2s for 5m. Paging @alex and @sam-ops
oncall-bot: Runbook: r/inference_throttle -> start mitigation -> page infra if CPU/GPU saturated

alex: seeing increased queue depth on a subset of pods, not all models. reproducing on staging. low-level hypothesis: autoscale misfired on a subset of nodes.

sam-ops: thx. i'm on it. grabbing logs now. can someone check statuspage wording? customers already pinging support.

maria-ng: @eva-cs can you surface a short customer notification draft we can push in 10m? keep it factual and avoid premature root cause.

eva-cs: sure. draft below. feedback welcome.
```
We are experiencing elevated inference latency for some hosted API requests in the eu-west-1 region. Teams are actively investigating and implementing mitigations. Some requests may experience slower responses; no data loss reported. We will update with a timeline within 30 minutes.
```

alex: that's fine but add an explicit bit about "if you're seeing errors please retry with exponential backoff" and mention dedicated customers unaffected if true? are dedicated pools impacted?

sam-ops: confirmed: dedicated pools not impacted. it's only shared hosted fleet in eu-west-1. add "dedicated and private deployments are unaffected" to avoid confusion.

comms: quick note on public wording: avoid technical terms like "autoscale" and "pods". prefer "capacity" or "infrastructure". Also suggest a short tweet-ready line for social.

maria-ng: tweet draft attempt: "We're investigating elevated latency for API requests in EU-West. Our teams are mitigating; some requests may be slower. We'll post updates on status.redwood.ai — apologies for any disruption." Thoughts?

darren: good. maybe shorten to 240 char safe: "We're investigating elevated API latency in EU-West. Our teams are working on a fix. See status.redwood.ai for updates." Keep link and no jargon.

ops-lead: operational note: begin on-call handoff in 45m. @alex please capture current mitigation steps in the thread so next on-call can pick up.

alex: mitigation steps so far: 1) increased target replicas on shared pool for eu-west; 2) rolled a temporary config to reduce batching window from 40ms -> 10ms for smaller models; 3) disabled a recent routing feature that sent traffic to experimental quantized instances. Observed p99 drop ~30% after step3.

sam-ops: logs: attaching snippet (truncated)
```
[2026-06-12T14:03:12Z] queue_depth=42 instance=redwood-hosted-3 gpu_util=75% p99=1.35s
[2026-06-12T14:04:20Z] queue_depth=12 instance=redwood-hosted-1 gpu_util=57% p99=0.92s
```

comms: ok here's a short internal template for a status update we can push to #general and cc customers: please review.
```
Status update (public): We are investigating elevated API latency for hosted requests in EU-West. Our engineers have implemented mitigations and are seeing partial improvement. We will post another update in 30 minutes or when we have a clear remediation timeline. Impact: increased latency for some hosted API calls. Dedicated/private deployments unaffected. No data loss reported.
```

comms: and a customer email header/body variant:
```
Subject: Service update — brief latency impact in EU-West
Hi — we wanted to let you know we're investigating increased latency for hosted API requests in EU-West. We're actively mitigating and will share updates via status.redwood.ai. If you are experiencing errors, please retry with exponential backoff and contact support with request IDs.
```

eva-cs: LGTM. Adding note: include contact path for customers on contracts (account team + support).

maria-ng: also we need PR approval flow for any public blog/tweet that references incident. @pr-team can someone pre-approve standard wording? this is a recurring ask.

pr-team: we have a 2-step signoff: Comms lead + Legal for any message that mentions root cause or contractual impact. For short status posts we only need Comms lead. We'll keep a vetted set of one-liners for social.

alex: for this incident i'd avoid root cause in public posts until postmortem. We're not 100% on autoscale bug vs upstream provider networking blip.

sam-ops: agree. ops-only detail: we've opened a provider ticket (ticket# 987654). sharing with infra team.

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: @alex will hand off to @darren at 15:00 UTC. Handoff checklist: current mitigation actions, open tickets, any customer-facing messages, metrics dashboard links.

alex: handing off now — notes below. uptime dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/ops/eu-west-1
Open tickets: provider-987654 (networking), runbook-inference-throttle-22, support-1234 (customer inquiries)
Mitigations active: reduced batching window, increased replicas, routing rollback. Observed p99 down from 1.4s -> 1.0s post-rollback.

darren: taking over. i'll monitor p99 and double-check autoscaler logs + k8s events. will update timeline and coordinate with comms for next public update.

comms: next public push idea (30m): small update noting mitigations and partial improvement. Example: "Update: We've implemented mitigations to reduce API latency in EU-West and are seeing partial improvement. We're continuing to monitor and will post a follow-up in 30 minutes."

maria-ng: tiny nit: in status page we should use brackets for region and UTC timestamp, e.g., "[EU-West, 14:30 UTC]" so it's clear. Also include contact for affected customers.

eva-cs: i'll patch the status page now with the above template + contact lines. publishing in 2m.

sam-ops: monitoring: queue depth currently 8, p99 ~0.98s, errors stable. will open new thread if regression.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: statuspage updated by eva-cs at 1792102420

comms: after the incident we should run a quick retro on messaging: what phrasing reduced customer confusion, what caused follow-up questions. capture in postmortem.

darren: noted. i'll add a messaging section to the postmortem template. assigning to @maria-ng and @comms for review.

maria-ng: thanks. any objections to the tweet going live after the next public status update? want to keep them synchronized.

comms: no objections. will queue the tweet copy under scheduled social and hold publish until status update posted.

alex: thanks all. tagging this thread for the postmortem.

oncall-bot: incident set to "mitigated" at 1792106129 — monitoring for 1h before close.
